notes.title: Coming Soon: Undo Feature Update
notes.content:
We are working on one of the most requested features: Undo.

Press Backspace or click the new button near Restart to undo your last move.

Undo will be unlimited, so you can freely experiment with different paths.

The old “Lose” screen will be removed. If you get stuck, just undo instead of restarting.

This update is planned to arrive in about 10 days.
Stay tuned and thank you for playing 🐍
